text:
Taylor: quick midday async — 1) what I did 2) blockers 3) today. focus: api edge + routing policies + auth + rate limits

Rina: did a pass on the new route matching heuristics this morning. found a case where path-prefix and host rules were both matching unexpectedly.

Omar: ah saw that in staging too, thanks for catching it. I pushed a small fix to `router::match` to prefer exact host matches over fallback prefixes.

Taylor: nice. which PR? can you drop the link?

Omar: https://git.internal/rw/repo/pulls/4821 — simple reorder, tests included. left a comment for @Priya about backward compatibility.

Priya: reviewed, left one nit on the docstring. main blocker: we still see a surge of 429s from a single tenant in us-west-2 during replay tests.

Taylor: surge = sustained ~600 rps with bursts at 2k, right?

Priya: yep. it's tripping the global token-bucket before per-route rules kick in. looks like our global limiter is too aggressive for dedicated instances.

Kai: timeline: I can look at adjusting the global bucket scaling policy later today. quick question — do we want global bucket to be autoscaling based on committed capacity or based on recent 1m QPS?

Taylor: decision: prefer committed capacity for Dedicated, recent 1m QPS for Hosted. we'll add a flag `limiter.mode: committed|dynamic`.

Rina: sg. I'll add a config toggle to the ingress controller and a migration script so private deployments keep current behavior.

Omar: related: auth side — token introspection cache TTL is 15s, might be causing a lot of upstream calls under burst. should we increase to 60s for tenants with stable sessions?

Priya: we can, but need to add a bypass for logout events. otherwise session invalidation lag.

Taylor: implement TTL override per-tenant and wire logout events to invalidate cache key. Priya, can you draft the change?

Priya: on it. plan: add `auth.cache_ttl` in tenant config + `/invalidate_session` event handler.

Kai: FYI I'm running a staging experiment with `limiter.mode=committed` for tenant alpha-7 to measure tail latency. will report numbers by EOD.

Taylor: thanks. small ops ask: if anyone's touching rate rules today, please post the exact rollout window here and ping @deploy-bot before canary.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window accepted — please send `/canary start 2177782000 2177790000` when ready. :robot_face:

Omar: code-review ping for PR 4821 + perf test results in the PR description. prefer one more +1 before merging.

Rina: taking a look now. expect comments in ~30m.

Priya: draft for auth cache TTL change up on branch `auth-ttl-tenant` — needs review for event wiring.

Taylor: blockers?

Priya: main blocker resolved: we found the missing invalidation hook. will test locally.

Kai: no blockers from infra side. just need to confirm metrics naming after config toggle.

Taylor: today's top priorities: 1) merge router match fix (Omar) 2) auth TTL + invalidation (Priya) 3) limiter.mode rollout plan + canary (Kai + Rina) 4) watch alpha-7 staging for 429 regressions.

Omar: noted. I'll wait for Rina's review then merge and roll out small canary.

Rina: review done — two tiny nits, both addressed. leaving +1 after CI passes. :thumbsup:

Priya: will open PR for the invalidation endpoint in ~1h.

Taylor: cool. ping here when canary starts. thanks all.

Kai: ping — canary scheduled to start at 2177782000 per deploy-bot. I'll post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: canary started at 2177782000 for change set `limiter-mode-committed-alpha7`. monitoring: latency, 5xx, 429.

Taylor: great — watching.

Omar: quick FYI — perf tests show tail latency unchanged, 429 count down 85% for alpha-7.

Priya: auth TTL changes look good in local smoke. will push to staging after tests.

Rina: rolling migration for ingress config in staging this afternoon.

Taylor: end of thread: leave any follow-ups here. thanks!
